subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
He has / no / influence about / me.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. influence about .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "influence about"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct preposition to use with the word "influence" is **"on"**, not "about".
 
• The corrected sentence should read as: **He has no influence on me.**

Correct sentence: *He has no influence on me*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The use of correct prepositions is essential to ensure grammatical accuracy.
 
• Common prepositions used with "influence" include **"on"** and **"over"**.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• Correct: His advice had a great influence **on** my decision.
 
• Incorrect: His advice had a great influence **about** my decision.
